design: Right jaw pivot ring held by a screw: a one-piece capped ring (plain sleeve, no thin flange, closed inner end with an M2 pilot) on the right (-Y) jaw arm boss, whose end is cut back 2 mm by hand, held by one M2 x 8 driven from outside through the existing boss hole drilled to 2.5

approved.history: 2026-10-29: the two-piece option (old ring plus a separate dia 12 retaining disc and M2 x 10) was shown first; Shawn asked for one piece. A one-piece capped ring on the uncut boss would reach 3.5 mm further inboard and the right arm would have to bend about 8 mm to spring the jaw in, so the boss end is cut back 2 mm (concept picture jaw_ring_onepiece.png, rule: nothing inboard of today's envelope). Shawn then dropped the 0.3 mm flange: with the screw the ring cannot slide off, and the jaw is held axially by the four ID15 horn screws on the +Y side.

geometry.says: nothing inboard of the old ring end (y -37.5): springing the jaw in needs no extra bend
outer diameter 14 like the old sleeve, no flange (the old flange was dia 16.4)
